instruction: In README.md's table of MCP tools, mark am_get_aaak_spec as deprecated: its status becomes ⚠️ instead of ✅, and its description becomes "The AAAK compressed-memory dialect reference. Deprecated: new memories no longer use it". Every other row keeps its status. Change nothing else.
